			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-05-23')                  AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE)) AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-05-23')
            AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (
                        InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328','MPR1000200','MPAR100041')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT
    (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)                    AS "Start Date",
    perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id                           AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    perf_data.security_name                                 AS "Security Name - Current",
    perf_data.bloomberg_code                                AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    perf_data.model_portfolio                               AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_start                         AS "Total Market Value QC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow QC",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_end                           AS "Total Market Value QC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency  AS "Total PnL QC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_start                         AS "Total Market Value PC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow PC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_end                           AS "Total Market Value PC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency - perf_seclvl.period_result_node_by_node_local AS "FX PnL PC",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data
INNER JOIN performance.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl
        ON perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_1 = perf_data.model_portfolio
       AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-05-23')
ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,
         perf_data.bloomberg_code

WITH latest_meta_run_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(df_meta_run_date) AS max_run_date

    WHERE SUBSTRING(index_clip, 1, 6) = '2I65BY'
),

    SELECT MAX(file_date) AS max_file_date
    FROM market.markit_credit_index
    WHERE SUBSTRING(index_clip, 1, 6) = '2I65BY'
)
SELECT
    idx.index_family,
    idx.index_name,
    idx.annex_date,
    idx.index_series,
    idx.index_version,
    idx.index_factor,
    comp.index_clip,
    comp.component_ref_entity_ticker,
    comp.component_ref_entity_name,
    comp.component_ref_entity_red,
    comp.component_ref_entity_record_date,
    comp.component_ref_entity_type,
    comp.component_ref_entity_weight AS component_weight,
    comp.component_coupon_type,
    comp.component_currency,
    comp.component_maturity,
    comp.component_coupon,
    evt.red_entity_code,
    evt.reference_entity,
    evt.ticker,
    evt.cerrd AS event_determination_date,
    evt.corporateaction_event_date,
    evt.default_date,
    evt.type,
    evt.event_type,
    evt.auction_date,
    evt.tier_name,
    evt.auction_price,
    evt.auction_cash_settlement_date AS settlement_date

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 03
		AND hour between 05 and 06
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-03 05:35:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

FROM (with asset_class_base as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, node_name as pbor_node_name
		, "level" as split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_lc' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%_qtd_%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%_3m_%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%_fytd_%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%_1y_roll_%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%_4yp_%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%_5y_roll_%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, node_name 
			, "level"
			, time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where
			dataset_id = 'ASSETCL_CMB'
			and periods_per_year = 12
			and "level" = 1
			and node_name != 'Excluded' -- Per Michael Brown from Performance team, the Excluded node should be excluded from reporting
	) pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
		  ]
	) unpivot ( metric, value )
), asset_class_clean as (
	select
		  asset_class_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, cast( format( '%1$tY%1$tm%1$td', business_date ) as int ) as business_date_int
		, date_format( business_date, '%Y-%m' ) as year_month
		--, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', calendar_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		asset_class_base
	where
		business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		/*and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD', '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) )
		and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) )*/
)
select * from asset_class_clean) AS "finsights_perf_returns_asset_class"

		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name

			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *

			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id

				, pnl_4yp_rc

				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0

				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot

		from

			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:

	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select

		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (

			  scd.dataset_id

			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */

				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD' then 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name

		, case

			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency

			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'

		, value
	from (
		select

			, time_weighted_return_rc as time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_lc as time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency

			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency

			, pnl_rc as pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_lc as pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_qtd_rc as pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fytd_lc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), cmb as (
	select * from scd_perf
	union all
	select * from perf
), cmb_clean as (
	select
		cmb.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case
			when period = '1D' then '1. 1-Day'
			when period = 'MTD' then '2. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '3. QTD'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '5. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '6. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		cmb
	where
		value is not null
		and business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		and not ( pbor_node_name in ( 'Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' ) and metric_type = 'Return' )
)
select * from cmb_clean) AS "finsights_perf_returns_income_daily"

				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (

	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select

		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'

		, value

			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )

		, case

CAST(c.vol AS decimal(22,6)) as vol,
CAST(d.cs01 AS decimal(22,6)) as cs01,
CAST(e.dv01 AS decimal(22,6)) as dv01,
CAST(f.pv AS decimal(22,6)) as pv
from (
select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "var95", run_id from

where business_date = '2025-06-02' 
and benchmark_name = 'Supplementary Balancing Fixed Income (S)' and hierarchy_type = 'RISK' and hierarchy_node = 'CPPIB-ALL'
and analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' and percent_confidence_level = 95 and run_id in
( select run_id from dag_runs where dag_id = 'active_risk_dag' and business_date = '2025-06-02')
) as var
left join 
(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "mean", run_id from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_mean 
where business_date = '2025-06-02' and analytic_type = 'MEAN_10YR'
) as b on var.run_id = b.run_id and b.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name   
and b.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and b.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node
left join 
(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "vol", run_id from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_vol 
where business_date = '2025-06-02' and analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR'
) as c on var.run_id = c.run_id and c.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name 
and c.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and c.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node
left join
(
select benchmark_name,  hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, sum(total) as cs01, run_id
from (
select *, reduce(cs01, 0 , (s, x) -> s + x, s -> s) AS total from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_cs01
where business_date = '2025-06-02' 
) group by benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, run_id

SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */

	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join

					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )

		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null

		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2

	  id_model_portfolio

WITH prev_business_date AS
         (
             SELECT
                 max(fact.business_date) as business_date
             FROM radar_reporting_uat.fact_cr_exposure fact
             WHERE
                 fact.business_date < '2025-05-29'
         ),
	current_exposure AS
	  (
	    SELECT

		  child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	      coalesce( country.name, child.domicile_country_code ) AS country_code,

	      SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.st_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS st_exposure,

	    WHERE

		  and fact.business_date = child.business_date
		  and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
		  AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
	      AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) <> 'NETTING'
	      AND
	        (
	          parent.is_fi = 'Y'
	          OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
	          OR EXISTS
	            (
	              SELECT 1
	              FROM radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
	              WHERE
	                parent.business_date = sibling.business_date 
					and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
	             )
	        )
	      AND (
			EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
			OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
		  )
          AND child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id != child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	    GROUP BY
	      child.party_name,
	      child.cppib_party_id,
	      child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
		  child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	      coalesce( country.name, child.domicile_country_code ),
	      child.rtg_final,
	      child.rtg_outlook
	  ),
	prev_exposure AS
	  (
	    SELECT
	      child.party_name,
		  child.cppib_party_id,
	      child.rtg_final AS prev_rtg_final,
	      SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.st_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS prev_st_exposure,
		  SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.mt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS prev_mt_exposure,

	      INNER JOIN radar_reporting_uat.fact_cr_exposure fact
		    ON child.business_date = fact.business_date and fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      INNER JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
		    ON child.business_date = parent.business_date and child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      INNER JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
		    ON fact.business_date = pos.business_date and fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
			AND UPPER( pos.PRODUCT_TYPE ) <> 'NETTING'
	    WHERE
	        (
	          parent.is_fi = 'Y'
	          OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
	          OR EXISTS
	            (
	              SELECT 1
	              FROM radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
	              WHERE
					parent.business_date = sibling.business_date
	                and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
	             )
	        )
	      AND (
			EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
			OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
		  )
          AND child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id != child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		GROUP BY
	      child.cppib_party_id,
	      child.party_name,
	      child.rtg_final
	  ),
	  child_level_exp_limits AS
	    (
	      SELECT
	        parent.cppib_party_id AS cppib_party_id_parent,
	        child.cppib_party_id AS cppib_party_id_child,
	        SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.st_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS st_exposure,
	        MAX( child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS st_smd_threshold,
	        SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.mt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS mt_exposure,
	        MAX( child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS mt_smd_threshold,
	        SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.lt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS lt_exposure,
	        MAX( child.lt_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS lt_smd_threshold
	      FROM
	        radar_reporting_uat.fact_cr_exposure fact,
	        radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent,
	        radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
	        radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
	      WHERE
	        fact.business_date = '2025-05-29'
		    and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
		    and fact.business_date = child.business_date
		    and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
	        AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	        AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	        AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
	        AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) <> 'NETTING'
	        AND
	          (
	            parent.is_fi = 'Y'
	            OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
	            OR EXISTS
	              (
	                SELECT 1
	                FROM radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
	                WHERE
	                  parent.business_date = sibling.business_date
					  and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                  AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                  AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
	               )
	          )
			AND (
				EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
				OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
			  )
            AND child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id != child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      GROUP BY
	        parent.cppib_party_id,
	        child.cppib_party_id
	    ),
	  breaches_under_parents AS
	    (
			SELECT
            	cppib_party_id_parent AS cppib_party_id,
            	MIN
				  (
	                CASE
                        WHEN st_exposure / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
                            OR mt_exposure / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
                            OR lt_exposure / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
                            THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                        WHEN st_exposure / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                            OR mt_exposure / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                            OR lt_exposure / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                            THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
	                    WHEN st_exposure >= st_smd_threshold OR mt_exposure >= mt_smd_threshold OR lt_exposure >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	                    ELSE 'OK'
	                END
	              ) AS status
            FROM child_level_exp_limits
            GROUP BY
            	cppib_party_id_parent
    	)
	SELECT
	  'Y' AS has_children,
	  c.party_name,
	  CASE
          WHEN SUM(st_exposure) / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
              OR SUM(mt_exposure) / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
              OR SUM(lt_exposure) / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499

              OR SUM(mt_exposure) / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999

              THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
	      WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= st_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	      WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= mt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	      WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
		  ELSE coalesce( MIN( b.status ), 'OK' )
	  END AS status,
	  CASE

          WHEN mt_smd_threshold = 0 OR mt_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
          ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( mt_exposure ) ) / mt_smd_threshold * 100

	  SUM( lt_exposure ) / 1000000 AS lt_exposure,

      CASE
          WHEN lt_smd_threshold = 0 OR lt_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
          ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( lt_exposure ) ) / lt_smd_threshold * 100
      END AS lt_utilization,

	  MAX( p.prev_rtg_final ) AS prev_rtg_final,
	  dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= st_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS st_limit_blown,

	st.abor_security_id,
	es.sedol,
	es.isin,
	es.cusip,
	es.esm_incorp_country_code,
	es.security_name_id,
	smp.sst_custody_account_code,
	st.model_portfolio_id,
	st.business_transaction_code,
	st.settlement_currency,
	cast(st.trade_date as date) as trade_date,
	cast(st.payment_date as date) as payment_date,
	st.nominal,
	st.nominal_basis,
	st.elementary_transaction_code,
	st.interest_dividend_capital_event_quotation_currency,
	st.interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency,
	st.transaction_cancellation_flag,
	st.reconciliation_status,
	st.created_date,
	ep.party_id,
	ep.epm_party_name,
	st.transaction_number_in_originating_system,
	st.payment_amount_quotation_currency,
	st.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
	st.external_short_tag,
	st.settlement_date,
	st.quotation_currency,
	st.number_of_units,
	case 
		when ss.abor_security_type_id in ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') and st.abor_security_name like '%CAD%' then 'Y'
		when ss.abor_security_type_id in ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') then 'N'
	end cross_deal_indicator,
	st.settlement_location,
	es.esm_country_code,
	rec.country_ref_code,
	rcc_exchange_country.country_name as esm_country_name,
	rcc_incorp_country.country_name as esm_incorp_country_name,
	sp.portfolio_group_id,
	ss.abor_security_group_name,
	ss.abor_security_type_name,
	smp.model_portfolio_name,
	rcc_trade_country.country_name as country_ref_name,
	rcc.currency_name as quotation_currency_name,
	st.price as price_qc,
	st.price * st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as price_pc,
	st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency,
	es.cppib_country_of_exposure_name,
	es.cppib_currency_of_exposure_name,
	sp.portfolio_name,
	sp.portfolio_group_name,
	smp.investment_strategy_name,
	smp.investment_department_name,
	ss.abor_instrument_type_id,
	ss.investment_type_name,
	stc.abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
	stc.other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
	stc.abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
	stc.other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
	st.portfolio_id,
	st.ibor_reason,
	ss.abor_coupon_rate,
	st.dividend_per_share,
	st.borrowing_account,
	stc.coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
	stc.coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
	stc.coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
	stc.restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
	stc.restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
	stc.restitution_expected_settlement_currency,
	shm.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency
from (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by scd_transaction_number_primary_key order by business_date desc) as rn
	from trades_deals.scd_transactions tr
	where transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
) st
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by abor_security_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.enterprise_security
) es
	on st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id
	and es.rn = 1
left join reference.scd_model_portfolio smp
	on smp.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.scd_model_portfolio)
	and st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by scd_party_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from party.enterprise_party
) ep
	on st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id
	and ep.rn = 1
left join reference.scd_securities ss
	on st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
	and ss.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.scd_securities)
left join reference.reference_exchange_codes rec
	on es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
	and rec.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_exchange_codes)
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country
	on es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
	and rcc_exchange_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country
	on es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
	and rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
left join (
	select *, 
	row_number() over (partition by portfolio_id order by business_date desc) latest
	from reference.scd_portfolio
) sp
	on sp.latest = 1
	and sp.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country
	on rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
	and rcc_trade_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
left join (
	select abor_transaction_number,
    		business_date,
    		transaction_cancellation_flag,
    		trade_date,
    		max(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency else 0 end) abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then amount_quotation_currency else 0 end) other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
		max(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency else 0 end) abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then amount_portfolio_currency else 0 end) other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' then amount_portfolio_currency else 0 end) coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' then amount_quotation_currency else 0 end) coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' then amount_settlement_currency else 0 end) coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' then amount_portfolio_currency else 0 end) restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' then amount_quotation_currency else 0 end) restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' then amount_settlement_currency else 0 end) restitution_expected_settlement_currency
	from trades_deals.scd_transaction_cost
	group by abor_transaction_number, business_date, transaction_cancellation_flag, trade_date
) stc
	on st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
	and st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
	and st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by abor_security_id, portfolio_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from holdings.scd_holdings_main
) shm
	on shm.abor_security_id = st.abor_security_id
	and shm.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
	and shm.rn = 1
left join reference.reference_currency_codes rcc
	on st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
	and rcc.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_currency_codes)
where st.rn = 1 ) ds LIMIT 0

		date_trunc('minute', datetime)

	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

/* QuickSight f9d1753d-749c-44a7-9166-df9a8085276e */
SELECT "hierarchy_node" AS "69e79e97-1b91-47fa-9fc6-9dc9013f5c6d.hierarchy_node", "business_date" AS "69e79e97-1b91-47fa-9fc6-9dc9013f5c6d.business_date", "fiscal_quarter" AS "69e79e97-1b91-47fa-9fc6-9dc9013f5c6d.fiscal_quarter", "active_vol_10yr" AS "69e79e97-1b91-47fa-9fc6-9dc9013f5c6d.active_vol_10yr", "pv" AS "69e79e97-1b91-47fa-9fc6-9dc9013f5c6d.pv", "active_vol_number" AS "69e79e97-1b91-47fa-9fc6-9dc9013f5c6d.active_vol_number", "TenYr_Beta" AS "69e79e97-1b91-47fa-9fc6-9dc9013f5c6d.TenYr_Beta"
FROM (SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Real Assets~CORE' THEN 'Real Assets'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Real Estate~CORE' THEN 'Real Estate'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Infrastructure (P)~CORE' THEN 'Infrastructure'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Sustainable Energy Group~CORE' THEN 'Sustainable Energy Group'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Credit Investments~CORE' THEN 'Credit Investments'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Antares (P)~CORE' THEN 'Antares'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Active Credit ex. Antares~CORE' THEN 'Active Credit ex. Antares'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Private Equity~CORE' THEN 'Private Equity'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Funds & Secondaries~CORE' THEN 'Funds & Secondaries'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Direct Private Equity (S)~CORE' THEN 'Direct Private Equity'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Private Equity Asia~CORE' THEN 'Private Equity Asia'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Growth Equity (P)~CORE' THEN 'Growth Equity'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Listed Real Estate~CORE' THEN 'Listed Real Estate'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy PE Asia~CORE' THEN 'ISG PE Asia'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy Growth Equity~CORE' THEN 'ISG PE GE'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy DEILA~CORE' THEN 'ISG AE DEILA'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy FIG~CORE' THEN 'ISG PE FIG'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy Funds & Secondaries~CORE' THEN 'ISG PE F&S'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy SEG~CORE' THEN 'ISG RA SEG'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy AE Asia~CORE' THEN 'ISG AE Asia'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy Direct Private Equity~CORE' THEN 'ISG PE DPE'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy RE~CORE' THEN 'ISG RA RE'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy~CORE' THEN 'ISG Legacy'
        ELSE a.hierarchy_node
    END AS hierarchy_node,
    
    CAST(a.business_date AS DATE) AS business_date,

    -- Fiscal Quarter Tagging
    CASE
        WHEN a.business_date IN (
            SELECT MAX(business_date)
            FROM risk_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_vol
            WHERE month(date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (3,6,9,12)
              AND date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') < date_trunc('month', current_date)
            GROUP BY year(date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')), month(date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d'))
        )
        THEN CASE
            WHEN month(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (4,5,6)
                THEN 'F' || substr(cast(year(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar), 3, 2) || ' Q1'
            WHEN month(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (7,8,9)
                THEN 'F' || substr(cast(year(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar), 3, 2) || ' Q2'
            WHEN month(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (10,11,12)
                THEN 'F' || substr(cast(year(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar), 3, 2) || ' Q3'
            ELSE 'F' || substr(cast(year(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS varchar), 3, 2) || ' Q4'
        END
        ELSE NULL
    END AS fiscal_quarter,

    a.analytic_value AS active_vol_10yr,  
    b.pv, 
    CASE 
        WHEN b.pv IS NOT NULL AND b.pv != 0 THEN a.analytic_value / b.pv 
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS active_vol_number,
    
    TRY_CAST(beta.analytic_value AS DOUBLE) AS TenYr_Beta

FROM risk_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_vol a

LEFT JOIN risk_prod.benchmark_analytic_pv b
    ON a.hierarchy_node = b.node_name
    AND CAST(b.business_date AS DATE) = CAST(a.business_date AS DATE)

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        c.business_date, 
        c.analytic_value, 
        d.node_name
    FROM risk_prod.fact_analytic_md_rel_var c
    LEFT JOIN risk_prod.dim_hierarchy_node d
        ON d.dim_hierarchy_node_id = c.dim_hierarchy_node_id_1
        AND d.business_date = c.business_date
    WHERE c.portfolio_type_2 = 'SAP CORE'
      AND c.analytic_name = '10 Year Beta'
) beta
    ON a.hierarchy_node = beta.node_name
    AND CAST(beta.business_date AS DATE) = CAST(a.business_date AS DATE)

WHERE a.benchmark_name = 'SAP CORE'
  AND a.analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR'
  AND a.hierarchy_node IN (
      'Real Assets~CORE', 'Real Estate~CORE', 'Infrastructure (P)~CORE',

	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

/* cppi::b5aeec29e135863ba535cd041f3e585662fc0dc4aeac1352388b946de3234333 */
/* QuickSight bdb333a0-2923-4129-bf67-baf3e493e403 */
SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y Rolling'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y Rolling'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, node_name as pbor_node_name
			, "level" as split_level
			, time_weighted_return_rc as time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_lc as time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_rc as pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_lc as pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_qtd_rc as pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fytd_lc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from

		from

		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), cmb as (
	select * from scd_perf
	union all
	select * from perf
), cmb_clean as (
	select
		cmb.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case
			when period = '1D' then '1. 1-Day'
			when period = 'MTD' then '2. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '3. QTD'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '5. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y Rolling' then '6. 5Y Rolling'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		cmb
	where
		value is not null
		and business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		and not ( pbor_node_name in ( 'Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' ) and metric_type = 'Return' )

SELECT from_currency as from_currency,

    format_datetime(business_date, 'yyyyMMdd') as business_date
FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr

and business_date>=DATE '2000-01-01'
UNION

    ROUND(case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then MainTable.mid_price * CAD_Rate.mid_price else (1/MainTable.mid_price) * CAD_Rate.mid_price end, 8) as calc_mid_price,

    FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'

with pnl as (select pnl.portfolioname, pnl.reportdate, pnl.pnl_cad from experimental_cmf.gcs_ibor_portfolio_accounting_pnl pnl

    pnl_pct as (select pnl.portfolioname, pnl.reportdate, pnl.pnl_cad pnl_cad_pct from experimental_cmf.gcs_ibor_portfolio_accounting_pnl pnl

  and strategy_group_id in ('jp_eb')
